title: Mamdani Accuses Netanyahu of Spreading ‘Baseless Lies’ After U.N. Speech
summary_full: The Israeli prime minister accused Mayor Zohran Mamdani, an outspoken critic of Israel, of antisemitism. The mayor has become a political foil for the prime minister.
